name: AMD (Advanced Micro Devices)
old_description: AMD is a California-based semiconductor designer and manufacturer. Produces CPUs, GPUs and APUs (combined CPU/GPU chips) for PCs, servers and gaming consoles.
about:
AMD is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and was founded in 1969 as a semiconductor designer and manufacturer. The company began by developing integrated circuits and has grown into a major supplier of processing solutions for computing and graphics.

The company designs and produces central processing units (CPUs), graphics processing units (GPUs), and accelerated processing units (APUs) that combine CPU and GPU functions. Its products serve personal computers, servers, and gaming consoles. AMD employs between 2,000 and 4,999 people across its operations.

AMD serves the PC, gaming, and data center industries. Its technologies are used by leading businesses and trusted companies for artificial intelligence, embedded, and edge applications. The company highlights partnerships with major enterprises to solve complex computing challenges.

AMD differentiates itself by offering a broad portfolio of AI solutions spanning CPU, GPU, and adaptive computing, an open ecosystem approach based on open standards and co-innovation, and proven leadership in innovation delivering industry-leading total cost of ownership and efficiency across data center, edge, and endpoint deployments.
